stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Welcome aboard, Jaden Newbigging - the club is glad to host Wagga City GC today. Enjoy every hole.

stories.title: Four and Forgotten
stories.detail: Quadruple bogey on hole 2 - the committee has been informed and they are also confused

stories.title: What On Earth Happened
stories.detail: +8 on hole 3 - the scorecard needs a moment to recover from that

stories.title: The Nightmare Hole
stories.detail: Triple bogey on hole 7 - the scorecard just copped a beating

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Michael Douglas from 2nd to 25th - Freo topped the ladder all year and lost week one, no lead is safe
